structuredContent.body:
Six selected reads lacked private contracts and canonical bindings: client
registry lookup, three business-development reads, and Research Portfolio detail
and changes. This successor adds three cohesive schema/validator families and
binds them through the existing loader and sole operation registry. It reuses
the existing inert-data admission and hashing without changing public exports.

All 139 original capabilities and accepted boundaries remain: 96 selected and
43 deferred. Six complete source mappings move the ledger to 20 mapped and
76 selected unmapped. There are 21 typed operations because the action-item
binding remains partial. Every operation is unavailable, has a null handler and
pending qualification, and source connectivity remains disabled.

Domain and combined reviews: ACCEPT_SOURCE. Root replay passed 838/838;
the independent replay passed 871/871 (838 existing plus 33 new controls),
and the source/receipt audit passed 426/426. Registry UTF-16 and portfolio continuation defects were repaired by their
authors and independently replayed. Original raw failures and negative controls
remain in the packet. Public distribution passed 7/7 with unchanged public bytes
and successful generated/type checks. Owned check groups exited and descendants
were reaped.

This draft is stacked on accepted PR22, preserving main and RC1. G1 remains OPEN
and G2–G7 unentered. Gateway trusted context for portfolio execution, current
source authority, real adapters and runtime qualification remain separate. The
native owner retains the approved 33-case RC1 sequence. No runtime, proxy,
worker, frontend, database, provider, cloud image, security or infrastructure
change, paid model call, source connection, deployment or merge is included.

Remaining decisions are documented without choosing semantics: the Clio-backed
research-evidence producer differs from its accepted portfolio boundary, and
memory administrator self-approval conflicts with the wrapper's other-reviewer
requirement. Next implementable reads are SAM requirements/government landscape,
then opportunity detail/search/client context.

Source and handoff: `docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-CAPABILITY-NEXT-20261012.md`;
priorities: `docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-CAPABILITY-NEXT-PRIORITIES-20261012.md`.
Exact accepted source candidate: `c463f7f7e7580e26d07b31c5f4020eaa469d4f67`
(tree `552b333286dc42d98602fc255b2e3ec75d834c4a`).

Packet freeze: `703cfd31af3b62aad031b0f998520037cdd3134d` (tree `056b838224d96a99408e4d84f16da1a7e3ca0789`). The 218-member manifest
SHA256 is `8d69bcda57c1da9a90bf17a01f696fca63178b43caedfc3b1b2abe06c3b0e0c2`. Original author and reviewer branches
are published for exact-commit recovery.
